gauge.name: Yellowstone River near Sidney

impacts.statement: Ice jam will threaten city bridges.
Ice jam will threaten city bridges.
Severe ice jamming may threaten city bridges.
Richland Park north of Sidney begins to flood.
Flood stage. Expect low-land flooding to occur.
At stages of 14.0 feet and higher combined with 60,000 cfs or more will create under tow which can sweep people under water.
At river levels of 2.8 feet and lower, MDU power plant in Sidney needs to shut down due to lack of water in its intake pipe for the cooling towers.
